posts.raw_content:
After reading this post and the comments on it, I am reminded of what I hate about this site.

https://patriots.win/p/1AToYzqLrS/the-stock-market-crashed-today-b/c

Don’t get me wrong, this is arguably the best site on the internet. But at times it can be the most obnoxious place ever.

Trump speaks an obvious truth:

> you retards voted for communists. Now they’re doing commie shit and destroying the stock market. You only have yourselves to blame.

Is this a bit inflammatory? Sure. Is it also 100% true? Yes.

Yet the responses act like Trump is George Bush and betrayed every American patriot. 

> hurrr why didn’t Trump just let Iran get a nuclear weapon. Maybe he could have won the Muslim vote! Durrrr why did he deport the illegals so hard??? Doesn’t he care about the beaner-faggot vote?!

Trump isn’t to blame for the midterm loss. He already fulfilled his mandate. He won the white male Christian vote (only one that really matters). He couldn’t possibly win the midterms without betraying us. He is an A+ president. Even if I granted you that the Iran war was a disastrous mistake (it wasn’t) he still would be an A+ president.

Some of you are young and it shows. You have absolutely no idea how much better things have gotten because of Trump. He is quite literally the only reason we have a country left. We should be in a Hillary/Biden/Kamala timeline. He almost died to save us. He masterfully pulled off the greatest upset in political history in 2016, and another huge upset in 2024, even with all the rigging.

But you want to lay all the blame for the midterms at his feet? When he wasn’t even on the ballot.

I get it. You’re angry. You have every reason to be angry. You are living in clown world. Your country is being destroyed by trash. Your heroes are being shot and nothing is being done about it.

But this all reminds me of when my grandma died. My brother, in a heated rage, blamed my dad for it all. My dad did absolutely nothing wrong and is the best person I know. But my brother didn’t care. He was mad and wanted someone to blame. That is what you are all doing to Trump. My brother destroyed my family; You guys are destroying MAGA. 

This site is filled with some of the greatest patriots ever. Even the people who “hate” me here are top 1% of the country. EgregiousPhilbin, Ostia, ChickenInspector all the pretentious faggots who don nothing but call me a retard — still great patriots overall. Just a bit confused and filled with misguided anger.

This is what I’m happy about leaving. This site, despite the greatness of its userbase and moderation, has devolved into a Reddit type environment. People blaming innocent people for invalid reasons. People falling victim to group think. Rage and anger superseding logic. Enemy propaganda poisoning the well. It’s devolved into a shit show. 

I hope you all figure it out while I’m gone. Try to practice the golden rule and be nicer to each other. Don’t be so quick to accuse others of being a shill. I know I don’t have the right to preach this message, since I violate it all the time, but it’s what we all know needs to happen. We have to stop letting the enemy use our anger against us and divide us. Ronald Reagan won 49 states by uniting libertarians, conservatives, and maga-type populists. That is what we need to do now. Not fight over every fucking thing we can find to disagree about. 

I hope to be back one day if I ever get my life back together. As a single old man who destroyed my career by telling BLM faggots to go to hell, who lost most of the friends I had in my shithole blue state for the crime of supporting Adolf Trump, I have a long long way to go. I may never come back. I am 100% committed to not using social media one time until I get my shit together. 

If I have one piece of advice to give you all: listen to John Doyle. This kid is a wizard. He threads the needle perfectly. I’ve never seen anything like it. He reminds me of Charlie Kirk in the way he truly cares about this movement. He is the most based person I’ve ever heard in media. Big props to Glenn Beck (underrated patriot) for giving him a major platform. 

You will all love Doyle whether you’re someone who hates Israel or thinks we should support them somewhat. He is supremely reasonable. He is good at controlling anger and focusing on productive actions we can all take to save our country.

I hope you all can manage your righteous anger, stop blaming our favorite president, and enjoy your life. You are great people. You deserve good things. We all just need to focus and pray.

Things are bad, but it’s not as hopeless as you think. In 2015, I was CERTAIN our country was gone for. Then God sent us Trump.

> Things will all work out. They always do!

> — Donald J. Trump

Godspeed pedes.
